title: 差戻審　第10回弁論準備手続期日
contents: 日時：2026年6月19日　午後1時30分場所：名古屋高等裁判所「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」差戻審の第10回弁論準備手続期日が、2026年6月19日に開かれました。控訴人が第17準備書面を陳述しました。これに対して、被控訴人からは追加の主張がないことが確認されました。期日のやり取りで、控訴人から被控訴人に対して、被害者と控訴人が同性カップルであった事実も否認するのかと尋ねたところ、被控訴人は、元々交際関係にあったことや同棲していたことを積極的に否定するものではないものの、事件時に交際関係にあったか否かについて不知であるという主張である旨を明らかにしました。双方から補充の主張がないということで、尋問に向けて審理を進めることとなりました。次回期日は、2026年8月7日と指定されました。次回期日までに、控訴人の陳述書等、尋問に関する書面を提出することとなりました。次回期日も弁論準備手続という非公開の手続で行われるため、支援してくださる皆さまに、傍聴に来ていただくことはできません。また、差戻審では、控訴人と被害者とが「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情にあった」といえるかどうかが主要な争点であり、その内容が控訴人や被害者のプライバシーに関するものであるため、書面の公開は控えさせていただいておりますこと、ご了解ください。進捗については、CALL4で報告をさせていただきます。引き続きのご支援をよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Date and Time: June 19, 2026, 1:30 PM Location: Nagoya High Court The 10th preparatory hearing for the retrial of the lawsuit seeking survivor benefits for crime victims for same-sex partners was held on June 19, 2026. The appellant has submitted their 17th preparatory brief. In response, it was confirmed that the appellee had no further claims. During the hearing, the appellant asked the appellee whether they also denied the fact that the victim and the appellant were a same-sex couple. The appellee clarified that while they did not actively deny that they were originally in a relationship or living together, they claimed to be unaware of whether they were in a relationship at the time of the incident. Since neither side has requested any additional testimony, the proceedings will move forward with the questioning. The next scheduled date has been set for August 7, 2026. The appellant is required to submit their statement and other documents related to the examination by the next hearing date. The next hearing will also be a closed-door preparatory hearing, so we are unable to have our supporters attend as observers. Furthermore, the main issue in the retrial is whether the appellant and the victim were "in circumstances equivalent to a de facto marital relationship," and because this concerns the privacy of the appellant and the victim, we ask for your understanding that we are refraining from making the documents public. I will report on the progress via CALL4. We appreciate your continued support.

title: 差戻審　第９回弁論準備手続期日

contents_en: Date and Time: March 18, 2026, 11:00 AM Location: Nagoya High Court The ninth preparatory hearing for the retrial of the lawsuit seeking survivor benefits for crime victims for same-sex partners was held on March 18, 2026. (The originally designated date of February 13, 2026, has been cancelled.) A decision was made to dismiss the motion for a document production order during the deadline. The legal team has decided not to file an appeal and to continue the litigation until a judgment is reached. At the hearing, the appellee stated that the appellant's admissions and counterarguments to the 10th preparatory brief were not yet complete, and that the extent to which the facts were disputed would affect which witnesses to request, so they requested that the appellant clarify this. In response, the appellant will submit its admissions and counterarguments to the 10th preparatory brief by May 29, and the appellee will consider by the deadline whether to make any further arguments. The next scheduled date has been set for June 19, 2026. The upcoming proceedings will also be conducted in private as preparatory hearings, so we are unable to have our supporters attend as observers. Furthermore, the main issue in the retrial is whether the appellant and the victim were "in circumstances equivalent to a de facto marital relationship," and because this concerns the privacy of the appellant and the victim, we ask for your understanding that we are refraining from making any documents public. I will report on the progress via CALL4. We appreciate your continued support.

contents_en: Date and Time: December 4, 2025, 1:30 PM Location: Nagoya High Court The eighth hearing in the retrial of the lawsuit seeking survivor benefits for crime victims for same-sex partners was held on December 4, 2025. The appellee has submitted a "Statement of Opinion (Regarding the Appellant's Opinion on the Partial Disclosure of Documentary Evidence)." At the hearing, it was indicated that neither side had any further points to raise, and that the next step would be to decide on the motion for a document production order. The next hearing date has been set for February 13, 2026, but it was also suggested that the date may change depending on the decision regarding the motion for a document production order. As future proceedings will also be conducted in private, preparatory hearings, we regret that we cannot allow our supporters to attend as observers. Furthermore, in the retrial, the focus of the discussion is on disclosing documents from the time of the incident to determine whether the appellant and the victim were "in circumstances equivalent to a de facto marital relationship." Since the contents of these documents concern the privacy of the appellant and the victim, we ask for your understanding that we are refraining from making these documents public. contents_en: Date and Time: October 16, 2025, 11:00 AM Location: Nagoya High Court The seventh preparatory hearing for the retrial of the lawsuit seeking survivor benefits for crime victims for same-sex partners was held on October 16, 2025. The appellant has submitted a "Statement of Opinion Regarding the Partial Disclosure of Documentary Evidence." Furthermore, the appellee submitted Exhibit B-94. During the hearing, the presiding judge asked the appellee whether they understood that they had disclosed everything they could at that time. The appellee responded that they did disclose everything, but that they would consider disclosing more information individually in the future. Furthermore, the appellee stated that they would explain the reasons for withholding the appellant's opinion by the next hearing date. The court indicated that it would consider what action to take based on the appellee's counterarguments. The next scheduled date has been set for December 4, 2025. As future proceedings will also be conducted in private, preparatory hearings, we regret that we cannot allow our supporters to attend as observers. The appellee submitted their opinion statement (2) regarding the order to produce documents. Following on from the previous meeting, the order to produce documents was discussed. We coordinated the parts that the appellee could voluntarily disclose, including through individual discussions between the court and both parties. Based on the appellant's prioritization of disclosure requests to the appellee, the appellee has decided to consider submitting the documents and disclosing the masked portions. contents: 日時：2025年5月13日　午前11時場所：名古屋高等裁判所「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」差戻審の第4回弁論準備手続期日が、2025年5月13日に開かれました。控訴人から、被控訴人意見書に対する反論書を提出しました。前回期日に引き続き、文書提出命令について協議されました。文書提出命令の対象文書のうち、被控訴人が任意に提出したものについて、マスキングされた箇所について、部分的にマスキングの解除を求めるか、また、任意提出されていない供述調書については開示を求める対象を絞ることについて協議しました。次回期日（2025年6月24日）までの間に、・控訴人がマスキングについて解除等を求める書面を提出し、被控訴人がこれに対する検討をすること・控訴人が任意で開示されていない供述調書のうち、特に開示を求めるものの供述者の属性や推測される供述内容を特定し、被控訴人がこれに対する検討をすること・被控訴人が、控訴人反論書に対する反論を出すことが確認されました。今後の手続も弁論準備手続という非公開の手続で行われるため、支援してくださる皆さまに、傍聴に来ていただくことはできませんが、進捗についてCALL4で報告をさせていただきます。引き続きのご支援をよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Date and Time: 11:00 AM, May 13, 2025 Location: Nagoya High Court The fourth hearing in the retrial of the lawsuit seeking survivor benefits for crime victims for same-sex partners was held on May 13, 2025. The appellant has submitted a rebuttal to the appellee's statement of opinion. Following on from the previous meeting, the document production order was discussed. Regarding the documents subject to the document production order, we discussed whether to request the partial removal of masked portions of those voluntarily submitted by the appellee, and whether to narrow down the scope of disclosure requests for statements that were not voluntarily submitted. Between now and the next deadline (June 24, 2025), It has been confirmed that: the appellant will submit a document requesting the removal of masking, etc., and the appellee will consider it; the appellant will identify the attributes of the declarants and the presumed content of the statements that the appellant particularly requests to be disclosed among the statements that have not been voluntarily disclosed, and the appellee will consider this; and the appellee will submit a counter-argument to the appellant's counter-argument. The upcoming proceedings will also be conducted in private, preparatory hearings, so we will not be able to have our supporters attend as observers. However, we will report on the progress via CALL4. We appreciate your continued support.

contents: 日時：2024年12月20日　午前11時場所：名古屋高等裁判所「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」差戻審の第２回弁論準備手続期日が、2025年12月20日に開かれました。事実婚に当たるかどうかの判断のための要件、考慮要素に関し、前回期日で述べられた主張に対するそれぞれの反論として、控訴人から第16準備書面、被控訴人からは第９準備書面が提出されました。また、前回期日において、控訴人の知人等の供述調書の存在の確認と、任意の開示を求める求釈明の申立を行ったところ、被控訴人は複数の供述調書の存在を認めるものの、その開示に応じない意向を示しました。そのため、控訴人は、被控訴人が有する文書を提出させることを求める、文書提出命令申立てを行いました。以上の手続の結果、被控訴人が2025年2月18日までに、・事実関係に関する準備書面・文書提出命令申立についての意見書・任意に提出できる供述調書・その他、被控訴人側の書証を提出することになりました。次回期日は、2025年3月4日です。今後の手続も弁論準備手続という非公開の手続で行われます。そのため、支援してくださる皆さまに、傍聴に来ていただくことはできませんが、進捗についてCALL4で報告をさせていただきます。引き続きのご支援をよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Date and time: December 20, 2024, 11:00 a.m. Location: Nagoya High Court The second preparatory hearing for the retrial in the lawsuit to grant survivor benefits to same-sex partners of crime victims was held on December 20, 2025. Regarding the requirements and factors to consider in determining whether a marriage constitutes a common-law marriage, the appellant submitted Preparatory Brief No. 16 and the appellee submitted Preparatory Brief No. 9 as rebuttals to the arguments stated at the previous hearing. In addition, at the previous hearing, the appellant filed a motion for confirmation of the existence of statements made by the appellant's acquaintances and other parties, and for voluntary disclosure. The appellant, however, acknowledged the existence of several statements, but indicated its intention not to disclose them. As a result, the appellant filed a motion for an order to produce documents, requesting that the appellee produce documents in its possession. As a result of the above procedures, the appellee will: It has been decided that the defendant will submit: - Preparatory documents regarding the facts - Statement of opinion on the application for an order to produce documents - Optional statements - Other documentary evidence from the defendant's side. The next hearing will be held on March 4, 2025. Future proceedings will also be conducted in private as pre-trial proceedings. Therefore, we will not be able to invite all of our supporters to observe the proceedings, but we will be reporting on our progress on CALL4. We appreciate your continued support.

contents: 日時：２０２４年１０月２３日　午前１１時場所：名古屋高等裁判所「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」差戻審の第１回弁論準備手続期日が、２０２４年１０月２３日に開かれました。事実婚に当たるかどうかの判断のための要件、考慮要素に関し、控訴人から第15準備書面、被控訴人からは第８準備書面が提出されました。また、本件においては、控訴人とパートナーとの関係について、パートナーが殺害された事件の捜査の過程で、控訴人の知人等の供述調書が複数作成されていた可能性があるため、その存在の確認と、任意の開示を求める求釈明の申立を行いました。次回期日が２０２４年１２月２０日と指定され、控訴人は、被控訴人第８準備書面への反論とともに、パートナーとの生活実態に関する書証を出せるところまで出すこととなりました。また、被控訴人は、控訴人第15準備書面への反論とともに、求釈明申立書についての回答をすることとなりました。今後の手続も弁論準備手続という非公開の手続で行われます。そのため、支援してくださる皆さまに、傍聴に来ていただくことはできませんが、進捗についてCALL4で報告をさせていただきます。引き続きのご支援をよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Date and time: October 23, 2024, 11:00 a.m. Location: Nagoya High CourtThe first preparatory hearing for the retrial in the lawsuit to grant survivor benefits to same-sex partners of crime victims was held on October 23, 2024.Regarding the requirements and factors to consider when determining whether a marriage is a common-law marriage,The appellant submitted the 15th preparatory brief, and the appellee submitted the 8th preparatory brief.In addition, in this case, regarding the relationship between the appellant and his partner, there is a possibility that multiple statements from the appellant's acquaintances and others may have been prepared during the investigation into the murder of the partner, so we filed a motion for clarification requesting confirmation of their existence and their voluntary disclosure.The next hearing date has been set for December 20, 2024, and the appellant will submit as much documentary evidence as he can regarding his actual living situation with his partner, along with a rebuttal to the appellee's eighth preparatory brief.In addition, the appellant will submit a response to the petition for clarification along with a rebuttal to the appellant's preparatory brief no. 15.Future proceedings will also be conducted in private as pre-trial proceedings.Therefore, we will not be able to invite all of our supporters to observe the proceedings, but we will be reporting on our progress on CALL4.We appreciate your continued support.

title: 差戻審　第１回進行協議期日
title_en: Remand hearing: First progress consultation date
contents: 日時：２０２４年７月２２日　午後４時場所：名古屋高等裁判所「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」について、差戻審である名古屋高裁において、２０２４年７月２２日１６時から進行協議期日が開かれました。進行協議期日とは、裁判の進み方について協議をする期日で、今年3月の最高裁判決を受けて、差戻審でどのように進めるかの確認がされました。被控訴人の愛知県は、内山さんとパートナーが具体的に事実婚関係にあったことを争うという意向を示したため、この点が差戻審で審理されることになりました。次回期日は10月23日で、9月末までに控訴人・被控訴人の双方が、・どのような考慮要素に基づいてどういう審理をすべきか（判断・評価の軸）・立証の計画について主張する予定です。また、今後の手続について、内山さんとパートナーとの事実婚該当性が主な争点で、プライバシーに関わる内容が審理の中心になることが予想されるため、しばらくは弁論準備手続という非公開の手続で行われることが確認されました。そのため、支援してくださる皆さまに、傍聴に来ていただくことはできませんが、進捗についてCALL4で報告をさせていただきます。引き続きのご支援をよろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Date and time: July 22, 2024, 4:00 p.m. Location: Nagoya High Court A progress consultation date was held at 4:00 p.m. on July 22, 2024 at the Nagoya High Court, which is currently retrialing the lawsuit regarding "lawsuit to grant survivor benefits to same-sex partners of crime victims." A progress consultation date is a date at which discussions are held about how the trial should proceed, and following the Supreme Court ruling in March of this year, the way in which the case should proceed was confirmed in the remand hearing. As the defendant, Aichi Prefecture, indicated its intention to contest that Uchiyama and her partner were in a common-law marriage, this point was to be considered on remand. The next hearing is scheduled for October 23rd. Both the appellant and the defendant must - What factors should be considered and how should the hearing be conducted (axis of judgment/evaluation)? -I plan to argue my plan of proof. In addition, regarding future proceedings, it was confirmed that the main point of contention will be whether Uchiyama and her partner are in a common-law marriage, and that since matters related to privacy are expected to be at the center of the hearings, the proceedings will be conducted in private, known as pre-trial proceedings, for the time being. Therefore, we will not be able to invite all of our supporters to observe the proceedings, but we will be reporting on our progress on CALL4. We appreciate your continued support.

title: （差戻審）名古屋高等裁判所での進行協議期日を行います
title_en: (Remand) A consultation date will be held at the Nagoya High Court
contents: 「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を訴訟」について、差戻審である名古屋高裁において、２０２４年７月２２日１６時から進行協議期日が開かれることになりました。３月２６日の最高裁判決で「同性パートナーも事実婚配偶者として犯罪被害者等給付金の支給対象となり得る」ことが認められましたが、本件について事実婚関係があったかについて再度審理する必要があるとして、名古屋高等裁判所に差し戻されています。この名古屋高等裁判所での進行協議期日は、現時点で具体的な審理方針について裁判所から示されていませんが、被害者と内山さんとの関係が事実婚と評価できるかについて愛知県側が争うのか、認めるのか、仮に争うとすればどのような点を争うのかについて整理することになると考えられます。仮に愛知県側が争う場合には、双方に対して、生活実態などの事実関係や事実婚の法的な解釈などの主張を補充するのか、また追加で提出する予定の証拠があるかを議論し、差戻審の審理スケジュールを決めていくことになると考えられます。なお、進行協議期日は、非公開の手続であるため、みなさまに傍聴いただくことはできませんが、進行協議期日の結果は、改めてご報告いたします。引き続きのご支援よろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: Regarding the lawsuit regarding "lawsuit to grant survivor benefits to same-sex partners of crime victims," a progress consultation date will be held at 4:00 p.m. on July 22, 2024 at the Nagoya High Court, which is currently remanding the case. In a Supreme Court ruling on March 26, it was recognized that "same-sex partners may be eligible for crime victim benefits as common-law spouses," but the case was sent back to the Nagoya High Court, which ruled that a second review was needed to determine whether there was a common-law marriage. At present, the Nagoya High Court has not indicated a specific hearing policy for the date of the progress consultation, but it is thought that the court will decide whether Aichi Prefecture will contest or accept whether the relationship between the victim and Uchiyama can be considered a common-law marriage, and if so, what points it will contest. If Aichi Prefecture contests, it will discuss with both sides whether they will supplement their arguments with facts such as their living conditions and legal interpretation of a common-law marriage, and whether there is any additional evidence they plan to submit, and then decide the schedule for the remand hearing. Please note that the progress consultation sessions will be held in private and therefore will not be open to the public. However, we will report the results of the progress consultation sessions at a later date. We appreciate your continued support.

title: 最高裁　弁論期日指定のご報告
title_en: Report on designation of Supreme Court hearing date
contents: 「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を」訴訟で、最高裁の期日が開かれることになりました。　２０２２年８月２６日、名古屋高等裁判所で控訴審判決があり、一審と同じく請求が認められませんでした。そこで、最高裁判所での審理を求め、２０２２年９月４日、上告及び上告受理申立てを行いました。このたび、最高裁判所第三小法廷から弁論期日が指定されました。■弁論期日　日時：２０２４年（令和６年）３月５日　午後３時　場所：最高裁判所　第三小法廷　　　　（東京地裁、東京高裁とは別の庁舎ですので、ご注意ください）　期日は傍聴可能ですが、傍聴にあたって抽選になる可能性があります。裁判所ウェブサイトの案内をご確認ください。https://www.courts.go.jp/saikosai/kengaku/saikousai_kijitsu/index.html■期日の内容　上告人（原告）代理人から主張の概要を簡潔に述べます。　（この期日は、判決言渡し期日ではありません。判決に向けて、上告人の主張内容を裁判官に伝える期日です。）　■この事案の社会的意義・犯罪被害者給付金制度上、「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情にあった者」という文言（事実婚に相当する概念）に、同性間の関係が含まれるかについて、初めての最高裁が判断を示す事案になります。・他にも、「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情」という文言を用い、事実婚カップルを保護の対象にする法制度は２００件以上あり、地方自治体の条例などにも同様の文言を含むものがあります。最高裁の判断は、他の法令等の解釈にも影響を与え得るので、法律上同性のカップルが事実婚として法的保護の対象になりうるか否かについて、犯罪被害者給金制度以外の他の場面にも影響を与えます。・控訴審判決では、いわば「法律婚の選択肢がないカップルは事実婚にもなりえない」という法解釈が示されました。この法解釈に対し、最高裁がどのような判断をするかは、法律上同性のカップルの法律婚制度の利用をめぐる議論にも影響を与える可能性があります。
contents_en: The Supreme Court is set to hold a court hearing to ``provide same-sex partners with family benefits for crime victims.''On August 26, 2022, the Nagoya High Court issued an appeals court ruling, in which the request was not approved, as was the case in the first instance.Therefore, we filed an appeal and a petition for acceptance of the appeal on September 4, 2022, requesting a hearing at the Supreme Court.The date for the hearing has been designated by the Third Petty Bench of the Supreme Court.■Oral dateDate and time: March 5, 2024 (Reiwa 6) 3:00 p.m.Location: Supreme Court Third Petty Bench(Please note that this is a separate government building from the Tokyo District Court and Tokyo High Court.)It is possible to observe on the date, but there is a possibility that there will be a lottery for observing.Please check the information on the court website.https://www.courts.go.jp/saikosai/kengaku/saikousai_kijitsu/index.html■Contents of the due dateThe appellant's (plaintiff's) representative will briefly outline the argument.(This date is not the date for handing down the judgment. It is the date for conveying the content of the appellant's argument to the judge in preparation for the judgment.)■Social significance of this case・For the first time, the Supreme Court has decided whether the phrase "a person who was in a de facto marital relationship" (a concept equivalent to a de facto marriage) includes same-sex relationships under the crime victim benefit system. It will be a matter of judgment.・There are over 200 other legal systems that use the phrase "circumstances similar to de facto marriages" to protect common-law couples, and local government ordinances also include similar phrases. there is. The Supreme Court's decision may have an impact on the interpretation of other laws and regulations, so whether same-sex couples can be legally protected as common-law marriages may be affected by other laws other than the crime victim benefit system. It also affects the scene.・The appeals court judgment provided a legal interpretation that ``couples who do not have the option of legal marriage cannot become common-law marriages.'' What decision the Supreme Court makes regarding this legal interpretation may have an impact on the debate over the use of the legal marriage system for legally same-sex couples.

title: 名古屋高裁判決と、上告・上告受理申立てのご報告
title_en: Report on Nagoya High Court judgment and appeal/petition for acceptance of appeal
contents: 「同性パートナーにも犯罪被害の遺族給付金を」訴訟について、２０２２年８月２６日、控訴審判決の言渡しがありました。　名古屋高等裁判所は、犯罪被害者等給付制度に基づいて遺族給付金の支給を求めたところ、不支給とされたため、その裁定の取消請求を棄却した一審判決に対する控訴について、控訴を棄却する判決（以下「本判決」といいます。）を言い渡しました。　本判決が、判断の理由として挙げたのは、①　犯給法５条１項１号の「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情にあった者」について、婚姻の届出をすることができる関係であることが前提となっており同性カップルはそもそも対象外であるとして同性間の関係を含まない②　同条項に同性間の関係を含むとする解釈は法的安定性を害する③　被害者と同性の者を「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情にあった者」に含まないとする規定は憲法１４条に違反しないというものです。　本判決は、性的指向は自らの意思や努力によって変えることのできない属性であり、同居している相手方が殺害された場合、同性パートナーか異性パートナーかという事柄が精神的苦痛の大小を左右するとは認められないとしながら、精神的苦痛を受けた同性パートナーについては、給付制度の対象外としました。　判決も認定するとおり、性的指向は自らの意思や努力によって変えることのできないものであるうえ、人の人格の核心にかかわるものです。このような性的指向に基づく別異取扱いは、原則として肯定されるべきものではありません。　そうであるにもかかわらず、少数者の権利を護るべき司法がその役割を放棄し、同性愛者については法的に保護しなくても国民の信頼は損なわれないとするかのような本判決は、同性愛者に対する差別・偏見を助長するものであり、到底納得のできるものではありません。　わたしたちは、正当な判断を求め、２０２２年９月８日、最高裁に対して上告状と上告受理申立て書を提出しました。既に、上告理由書、上告受理申立て理由書も提出済みで、最高裁の判断を待っている状態です。　「事実上婚姻関係と同様の事情にあった者」という文言に、法律上同性の者が含まれるかどうかについて、最高裁が初めての判断を示すことになると思われます。　今後とも、よりいっそうのご支援のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。
contents_en: On August 26, 2022, an appeals court decision was handed down regarding the lawsuit "Same-sex partners should also receive benefits for bereaved families of crime victims." The Nagoya High Court issued a ruling to dismiss the appeal against the first-instance decision that dismissed the request for rescission of the ruling, as the survivors requested payment of benefits under the Crime Victims Benefits System, but were denied payment. (hereinafter referred to as the ``this judgment''). This judgment cited the reasons for the judgment as follows: (1) With regard to Article 5, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Criminal Compensation Law, it is premised that the person is in a relationship that allows them to report their marriage, and same-sex couples are eligible. (2) Interpretation that the provision includes same-sex relationships would undermine legal stability. This provision does not violate Article 14 of the Constitution. This ruling states that sexual orientation is an attribute that cannot be changed by one's own will or effort, and that if a partner living together is murdered, whether the partner is the same-sex partner or the opposite-sex partner determines the degree of emotional distress. However, same-sex partners who have suffered emotional distress are exempt from the benefit system. As the judgment also recognizes, sexual orientation is something that cannot be changed by one's own will or effort, and is related to the core of a person's personality. In principle, this kind of differential treatment based on sexual orientation should not be accepted. Despite this, the judiciary, which is supposed to protect the rights of minorities, has abandoned its role, and the ruling does not undermine public trust even if homosexuals are not legally protected. This is completely unacceptable, as it promotes discrimination and prejudice against homosexuals. We sought a just judgment and on September 8, 2022, submitted a final appeal and a petition for acceptance of final appeal to the Supreme Court. We have already submitted a statement of grounds for appeal and a statement of grounds for a motion to accept the appeal, and are awaiting the Supreme Court's decision. It is likely that the Supreme Court will make its first decision as to whether the phrase "persons who were in a de facto marital relationship" includes persons of the same sex legally. We look forward to your continued support.
